title: BPA Proposes 28 Substations for Fast-track Large Load Connections

meta.summary:
The Bonneville Power Administration presented a list of substations that could become available to quickly connect large loads to the grid, while extending the product-launch timeline to further flesh out technical details. 
 The post  BPA Proposes 28 Substations for Fast-track Large Load Connections  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
